node.title: Re: [WEBPERL] dynamically importing non-bundled modules via http
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: I've just updated the WebPerl repo with [https://github.com/haukex/webperl/blob/5306c3b8190790e25056c4ac07eb70aca1795ae6/experiments/use_http.html|use_http.html], which implements this idea. Since I've been thinking about how to get WebPerl into [https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Web_Workers_API|Web Workers], and synchronous HTTP requests are not deprecated there, this idea might become useful there!
